name: Peralta de Alcofea (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Peralta de Alcofea (the bars of Aragon and stones).
history: Municipal flag of Peralta de Alcofea; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
